Title: Similarity search in ChEMBL, DrugBank and UNPD
Description: Searches a combined collection of ChEMBL, DrugBank and the Universal Natural Product Database for the 100 structures closest to a query, restricted to molecules of up to 17 heavy atoms and totalling around 128,000 compounds. Merging bioactive, approved and natural product chemistry in one index means neighbours can come from any of the three, which is useful when looking for precedent across different chemical traditions. The database is queried remotely rather than bundled with the model.
Interpretation: List of the 100 nearest neighbours to the query molecule across ChEMBL, DrugBank and UNPD.
